'''Atoa''' was a little-known ice [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Atoan system]], in the [[Ghost Nebula/Legends|Ghost Nebula]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[near-Human]] [[Atoan]]s.

==History==
{{Quote|Sweep the area again. Execute anyone old enough to hold a weapon. Then burn the city.|Darth Vader to [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Voca]]|<ref name="DVatLC1" />}}
[[File:Atoa_attack.jpg|thumb|left|180px|The [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] fighting on Atoa.]]

A [[Atoan insurgency|major campaign]] for the Imperials took place at the planet shortly after the [[Declaration of a New Order|creation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The planet was [[Battle of Atoa|attacked]] by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] who had been led to believe that they were responsible for the disappearance of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Garoche Tarkin]]. In actuality, he had defected to [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Saro]], [[High Priest/Legends|High Priestess]] of Atoa, one of the rulers of the system.
